lemmas.primary_translation: to be put out of action; fare very badly; become very ill; be injured

definitions.translation: to be put out of action
to go very badly for someone or something

examples.no: løperen gikk ned for telling mot slutten av løpet
examples.en: the runner fared very badly towards the end of the race

examples.no: datasystemene gikk ned for full telling
examples.en: the computer systems went completely down

examples.no: spilleren fikk en albue i ansiktet og gikk ned for telling
examples.en: the player took an elbow to the face and was put out of action

examples.no: jeg går alltid ned for full telling når jeg får influensa
examples.en: I am always completely laid up when I get influenza
